topic_thesis: Your brain is hard-wired to hallucinate profit patterns in random noise, and 'Technical Analysts' are selling you that delusion for a fee.
strategic_angle: Expose 'Pareidolia' as the psychological hack used by chart-gurus to keep retail traders glued to screens, ignoring that 90% of intraday traders lose money due to this exact visual confirmation bias.
key_statistic: 90% of active retail traders lose money consistently over 3 years due to pattern-chasing.
pinned_comment_text: Are you trading based on real data or just seeing shapes in the clouds? If you've lost money chasing 'breakouts,' comment 'TRAP' and we'll send you the reality check guide. 📉👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Use the phrase 'Chart-u kulla irukura Mayakkam' (The delusion inside the chart). Emphasize that 'Pattern-u nu nambi panatha vidatheenga' (Don't lose money believing in patterns). Connect it to the common retail struggle of 'Intraday-la mudhalai izhanthathu' (Losing capital in intraday).
source_signal: Growing retail obsession with chart patterns and the high failure rate of F&O traders in India.
